RBSP B (VAN ALLEN PROBE B) was a spacecraft designed to study the Van Allen radiation belts, two cosmic bands of high-energy particles that are trapped in Earth’s magnetic field at altitudes ranging from about 400 to 93,300 miles (640 to 58,000 kilometers).
